name: Electronics Shop Simulator
detailed_description:
Electronics Shop Simulator is a captivating first-person simulation that brings the intricacies of running an electronics store to life.

Store Manager:

Design your shop to maximize efficiency and visual appeal. Decide how to display various tech products, manage your aisles effectively, and create a seamless shopping experience for your customers.

Supply Goods:

Order stock through an in-game computer. Unbox items, organize them in your storage area, and display everything from phones and tablets to laptops and gaming consoles on the shelves.

Repair Specialist:
Handle broken tech products by diagnosing issues and performing repairs. Ensure that customers are satisfied with the restored items and enhance your reputation for quality service.

Market Dynamics:
Navigate the fast-paced electronics market. Buy items when prices are low and set competitive selling prices to achieve the perfect balance between customer satisfaction and profitability.

Expand Your Business:

As profits grow, think about reinvesting in your shop. Expand your physical space, upgrade your store’s interior, and continuously adapt to the ever-changing demands of the electronics market.

In Electronics Shop Simulator, every decision counts. Will you take the challenge and transform a small shop into a thriving electronics hub while maintaining customer satisfaction and managing your finances?

short_description: Manage your own electronics store. Manage inventory, set prices, sell to customers, repair products, hire staff, and expand your store. Online orders, market dynamics, competition, and more are coming soon.
supported_languages: English, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4440 with 3,1 GHz or AMD FX-8150 with 3,6 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 Ti (2 GB VRAM) or AMD Radeon RX 460 (2 GB VRAM) or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3820 with 3,6 GHz or AMD FX-8350 with 4,0 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 (4 GB VRAM) or AMD Radeon RX 570 (4 GB VRAM) or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
